title: Suzanne RP NDE 4365
content: I was in 11th grade and attended the local high school. I had an after school part time job at a doctor's office as a clerk. On this particular day, I had a dental appointment. I went to work for an hour or two and then went upstairs in the same medical building to the dentist. I had a cavity filled and was given Novocain for pain, so one side of my jaw was numb. After the dentist, I worked for another hour or so and then I left to go meet a friend. We had decided to meet at about 5:30 pm at top of Sav-On which was rooftop parking. Sav-on had an interior stairwell although inside had full-length windows facing the street. I parked on the top lot and my friend who was always late didn't disappoint, so I went inside Sav-on to get this particular flavor of yogurt that I hadn't had anywhere else - Apple Pie a La Mode. Sav-on was sold out of it. So, I went back to my car and on the way up the stairwell a man was coming down and we nodded to each other. Evidently, this same man followed me up the stairs and to my car. I did not realize this until I was seated in the car with my keys in my lap and I pushed the car door open and out in order to slam it shut and that is when the assailant was shockingly there. He got in between the car and the door, thus blocking my ability to close the car door. He knelt down and put one hand on my mouth and the other hand into a fist punching me on the numb side, so I couldn't feel anything. He told me to shut up and give him the keys. I never looked directly at him even though he was inches from me, then he strangled me. The last thing I remember was the graffiti on the wall in front and trying to peel his hands off and then I passed out. It was still daylight out and I don't remember doing this, but I did get up from the parking lot and then fell down on my elbow. Somehow, I felt my way down the stairs. There was a person on the public phone and they helped me to the bathroom. They asked me who did this etc. They asked me where I had come from and I replied the dentist. They asked for my home phone number and I gave my work number. The secretary came over and took me to the office and the doctor, my boss, stitched the back of my head and had the various specialists in the building check my eyes and teeth. My parents were called and they took me to the hospital where I had CT Scans and in between I was questioned by the police. I believe the tunnel of light occurred when I was removed from the car and dropped on the pavement hitting the back of my head.
